hero.title: One view for the whole family.
hero.body: Kynite brings calendars, routines and rewards together in one place — on your phone, and on the tablet on the kitchen wall.
hero.reassurance: Free to try. Your family is set up in a minute.

features.title: Everything home has to hold
features.body: No more scattered lists and messages. Everyone sees the same thing, and the wall tablet shows it from across the room.

calendar.title: Family calendar
calendar.body: Link your Google calendars and see at a glance who needs to be where.

routines.title: Routines
routines.body: Morning and bedtime rituals as steps children can tick off themselves.

rewards.title: Stars and rewards
rewards.body: Celebrate what goes well, with a savings goal the whole family works towards.

hub.title: Wall display
hub.body: A paired tablet on the wall shows today, legible from the other side of the kitchen.

cta.title: Start today with a calmer house
cta.body: Create your family, invite the other parent, and put the tablet on the wall.
